components.indexAggregation: mean of measured local fold * sqrt(local paired edge), times supported continuity (minimum 0.20)
components.localMapMeaning: measured local support intensity; no confidence or pixel disease severity
components.meaning: visible-supported-contour-fold; not probability, volume or clinical severity
components.normalization: 2D eye axis and face width; no z/depth

scopeLimits: One already transformed noisy development regression; no natural-photo general accuracy claim.
Partial positive polygons and criterion-specific reviewed negatives only; unlabeled pixels remain unknown.
Strong-positive source map drops short support outside its annotation; those unknown pixels are not declared false positives.
A coherent component must span one coarsest configured Gabor period in the visible target support. Short real isolated segments may also be below this versioned scope.
AG local four-class skin-type work is separate; no integration or external call.
